crossRefs.note: His concubine played the prostitute against him, and went away from him to her father’s house to Bethlehem Judah, and…
Her husband arose and went after her to speak kindly to her, to bring her again, having his servant with him and a…
“They say, ‘If a man puts away his wife, and she goes from him, and becomes another man’s, should he return to her…
They shall fine him one hundred shekels of silver, and give them to the father of the young lady, because he has given…
Yahweh says, “Where is the bill of your mother’s divorce, with which I have put her away? Or to which of my creditors…
Pharisees came to him testing him, and asked him, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?”

translations.web: (but if she departs, let her remain unmarried, or else be reconciled to her husband), and that the husband not leave his wife.
translations.bsb: But if she does, she must remain unmarried or else be reconciled to her husband. And a husband must not divorce his wife.
translations.kjv: But and if she depart, let her remain unmarried, or be reconciled to her husband: and let ➔ not the husband put away his wife.
translations.asv: (but should she depart, let her remain unmarried, or else be reconciled to her husband); and that the husband leave not his wife.
